description: Multi-domain seed events for offline Horizon runs. Facts are illustrative structural markers for pipeline testing and baseline world-state coverage — not live news.

events.title: US–China strategic competition remains the primary geopolitical axis
facts: Export controls on advanced semiconductors and manufacturing equipment remain in force.
Both sides continue to deepen security partnerships with regional partners.
events.interpretation: This axis transmits into tech supply chains, capital allocation, and military posture; second-order effects dominate most other domains.

events.title: Global policy rates remain elevated vs 2010s baseline
facts: Major advanced-economy policy rates are still well above the post-GFC low decade averages.
Inflation has cooled from peaks in many economies but services inflation and fiscal deficits keep policy uncertain.
events.interpretation: Higher-for-longer or staggered cuts both reprice duration, risk assets, and the USD — critical for treasury liquidity and BTC beta.

events.title: AI data-center load and grid constraints lift nuclear and firm power narratives
facts: Hyperscalers have announced long-dated power purchase interest including nuclear-linked supply.
Uranium fuel-cycle capacity remains tight relative to announced reactor and SMR ambitions.
events.interpretation: Energy scarcity becomes a binding constraint on AI scale-out; nuclear miners/utilities and grid equipment sit at the intersection of Energy and AI bets.

events.title: Frontier AI remains compute- and energy-constrained
facts: Leading labs continue multi-billion-dollar training and inference buildouts.
Advanced GPU/accelerator supply and packaging remain bottlenecks.
events.interpretation: Personal leverage from AI tooling scales with model capability, but investable exposure is concentrated in semis, power, and platforms.

events.title: Indo-Pacific force posture and industrial base remain priority theaters
facts: Allied exercises and basing arrangements in the Indo-Pacific continue to expand in tempo.
Defense industrial capacity (munitions, shipbuilding, missiles) is a stated bottleneck for multiple governments.
events.interpretation: Military posture reinforces export-control and dual-use tech regimes; watch for escalation risk premiums in Asia supply chains.

events.title: Advanced-economy aging and tight labor markets constrain growth potential
facts: Working-age population growth is slow or negative in several major economies.
Labor force participation and immigration policy remain central political variables.
events.interpretation: Demographics support structurally higher wage/inflation volatility and automation demand (AI/robotics leverage thesis).

events.title: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing remains geographically concentrated
facts: Leading-edge logic capacity is highly concentrated in a small number of firms and locations.
Friend-shoring and subsidy programs aim to diversify capacity over multi-year horizons.
events.interpretation: Concentration is a systemic risk node linking geopolitics, AI compute, and capital expenditure cycles.

events.title: Bitcoin remains a high-beta expression of global liquidity and risk appetite
facts: Spot BTC ETFs and corporate treasury narratives have expanded institutional access channels.
BTC drawdowns and rallies remain correlated with broader risk-asset and real-rate moves in many regimes.
events.interpretation: For a Bitcoin accumulation thesis, watch real rates, USD liquidity, ETF flows, and regulatory clarity as first-order drivers.

events.title: Critical minerals and water stress bind energy transition and industrial policy
facts: Copper, lithium, and rare earths face multi-year project lead times relative to demand forecasts.
Regional drought and heat events increasingly affect hydro and thermal power reliability.
events.interpretation: Resource bottlenecks interact with AI power demand and defense industrial needs; not purely a green-narrative story.

events.title: AI and crypto narratives oscillate between euphoria and disillusionment in media cycles
facts: Coverage volume of generative AI remains elevated across business and tech media.
Retail and institutional narratives around Bitcoin flip with price regimes.
events.interpretation: Narrative intensity is a sentiment input, not a fundamental; use low confidence unless corroborated by capital-flow or policy facts.
